title: fix(electron): preserve UNC roots in path joins
body:
## Summary

Preserve the leading `//` authority marker when `joinPath` receives a UNC path, restoring relative WikiLink resolution for Electron vaults hosted on Windows network shares.

## Motivation

`normalizeSlashes` deliberately retains UNC paths as `//server/share/...`, but `joinPath` collapsed every slash run to one slash. `LinkIndex.resolve` uses `joinPath` to build relative candidates, so a source under `\\server\share\vault` produced `/server/share/vault/...` and could not match the normalized file path. When duplicate basenames prevented the fallback resolver from choosing a unique note, a valid relative WikiLink resolved to `null`.

## Changes

- Detect the UNC prefix before collapsing redundant path separators and restore the second leading slash afterward.
- Add a direct `joinPath` regression test.
- Add a `LinkIndex.resolve` integration test with ambiguous basenames, proving that relative UNC resolution succeeds without relying on the basename fallback.

## Testing

- [x] `pnpm test` — 34 files, 539 tests passed
- [x] `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p apps/electron-demo/tsconfig.json`
- [x] `pnpm build:electron-demo`
- [x] `git diff --check`

The repository-level `pnpm typecheck` command currently invokes `tsc` in the workspace root, which has no `tsconfig.json`; it exits after printing TypeScript help. The affected Electron application passes its scoped typecheck above.

## OpenSpec

No OpenSpec change: this is a focused bug fix that restores the path identity already preserved by `normalizeSlashes`.

## AI assistance disclosure

AI assistance was used to diagnose the UNC path bug, draft the small implementation, and generate the regression tests. The bug was reproduced with failing tests before the fix, and all listed checks were run after the fix. No dependencies were added.
